title: Warning: Oil Falls But Yields Still Rise: A Stock Market Breaking Point?
speaker: Gareth Soloway

macro_themes.view: 10-year yields rising even as oil falls signals fear of debt and entrenched inflation, a concern that could predate a bigger sell-off.
Adding $2-3T debt a year with ~$1T interest is unsustainable; he is very bearish on the next few years and expects rates to rise long term.
JOLTS and consumer confidence missed yet yields rose; ADP, Micron earnings and Friday NFP are the key catalysts this week.

calls.condition: Bullish while S&P holds above ~7575 (neutral-zone trend line); below it expects a sharp 5-10% sell-off in days. Rejection of 10y at 5.28% could send S&P to 8000; 10y breakout above 5.28% could push S&P into neutral/bearish zone.
calls.reason: Still above white trend line marking top of neutral zone; near-term gap fill acting as short-term support. Long term bearish on US debt/macro.
calls.quote: as long as we hold above this level, which is around 7,575 on the S&P, the chart is saying to me, remain bullish.

calls.condition: If 10y breaks above the 2007 pivot at 5.28%, target 5.5%; rejection there would be bullish for stocks.
calls.reason: Piercing the 2007 high pivot / long-term trend line; possible cup and handle on weekly; unsustainable US debt implies higher rates.
calls.quote: If we get above this, we are going to 5.5% on the 10-year yield.

calls.condition: Expects drop to ~$88 lower parallel channel line in next couple days; only breaks below on an Iran deal, then $70 or below; otherwise likely stays in rising channel.
calls.reason: Upward-sloping parallel channel; heading to lower trend line at $88; crude down 3% today.
calls.quote: oil again, I think we're headed down to $88 a barrel, this lower parallel trend line

calls.reason: Gravitating to beaten-up high-quality names that have stood the test of time.
calls.quote: I'm generally gravitating towards high quality names like a Clorox. Now Clorox has been beaten up

calls.reason: Beaten up at multi/near-decade lows, still pays a nice dividend.
calls.quote: it still pays a nice dividend and it's at multi almost decade lows
